reason: Adds an optional display currency label to subscription plans so prices can identify the currency represented by ambiguous symbols.
risk: The migration adds a NOT NULL column with a default to subscription_plans and can briefly take an exclusive table lock while PostgreSQL updates the table metadata.
mitigation: The change is additive and idempotent, uses an empty-string default for existing rows, and targets the small subscription plan configuration table. Keep the normal deployment health checks in place.
